main_text.p: μέτρῳ τὸν παῖδα [?] ἐκκεκομψμένῳ με-τρεῖν αὐτὸς τοῖς ἔνδον ἀδηδείᾳ, σφόδρα [?] ὑπολῶν, ὑποωρία-ας. ἀμέλη ὃ ἢ χρέος ὑποδιδῷς τριακοντα μῶν, ἐλάττον τέτρα-σι δραχμαὶς ὑποδι-δόναι. Ὁ φεάτορας ἐσιῶν, αἰτεῖν τοῖς αὐ-τ πασὶν ἐκ τῆςχ. κ. ὑψ. κοι-νῆς ὄψον. τὰ ἡ κατα-λεπέμβυα ὑπὸ τῆς τεαπέζης ἡμίσον τῶν ῥαφανίδων ὑπογρά-φειαν, ἵνα οἱ διάκο-νοιοῦντες παῖδες μὴ λάβωσιν.
main_text.head: ΠΕΡΙ ΑΚΑΙ-ρίας.
main_text.p: menfura si quid metia-tur,eam adhibet,cuiius fit fundum collisum & in-trorsus adactum: domesticis suis demensum ipse per quàm studiosè radès metitur ..... & si tri-ginta minas folucre ha-beat, vt quatuor tamen drachmæ de solido desi-derentur, operam dabit. quando etiam tribuleis conuiuio accipit, solet pueris suis obsonia è communi postulare: dimidiatos verò raphanos, si qui forte de mensa tollantur, annotat, ne eos pueri ministrantes capiant.
main_text.head: DE INTEMPE-stiuitate, siue infcitia temporis.
main_text.p: Intempestivitas est congressio molesta iis quibuscum congrediaris. Homoπτ[?]ξις λυπῶσα τοὺς ἐντυγχάνοντας[?]

page.notes: Greek reading is uncertain in several places (marked [?]); the Greek accents and breathings are as far as I can make them out at this scan. The marginal note beside "ἐκ τῆς" is an asterisk mark with the reference "χ. κ." and the Greek word "ὑψ.". The Greek note at the lower left is only partly visible. Letters marked [?] are doubtful. The visible Greek is "πτ?ξις λυπεσα" with "τοὺς ἐντυγχάνοντας" in the second line. The word "etiam" is printed with a worn e and may read as "ctiam". The line "tribuleis" is copied as printed. The paragraph continues beyond the visible part of the page.
